# Ring Mint

> Ring Mint is a custom engagement ring concierge. Rings are designed from scratch in CAD and manufactured to order, with natural or lab created diamonds sourced from a global network of more than two million stones. There is no showroom and no held inventory.

Founded by Chloe Alpert with the support of her family's jewelry business, Teaman Jewelry, in business since 1974. Serves clients across the United States and internationally. Contact: chloe@ringmint.com or WhatsApp +1 814 876 0095.

Elsewhere: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/theringmint) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ringmint) · [Pinterest](https://www.pinterest.com/theringmint) · [Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/ringmint.com)

## What makes the model different

Traditional jewelers buy stones and finished rings before knowing who wants them, and pay for retail space and sales staff. Those costs are recovered in the price of what sells. Ring Mint sources stones after a client describes what they want and manufactures after the design is approved, so there is no inventory cost and no incentive to steer a client toward a particular stone.

## Process

Seven steps, roughly two weeks of manufacturing once a design is approved:

1. Client gets in touch by form, email, or WhatsApp.
2. Call with the ring concierge; unlimited questions by text or WhatsApp thereafter.
3. Budget, deadline, stone preferences, and proposal timing are set.
4. Ring is designed from scratch in CAD; stones are sourced against the brief.
5. CAD is refined; an optional wax model is mailed for an at-home try-on.
6. Final design approved; ring manufactured to order in about two weeks.
7. Delivery with independent appraisal, final photographs, and fully insured shipping.

## Key facts

- Lab created diamonds are chemically and physically identical to mined diamonds: same carbon, same cubic crystal structure, same hardness of 10 on the Mohs scale. They cannot be distinguished by eye or with a loupe.
- Lab created diamonds cost a fraction of comparable natural stones, but their resale value is poor and falling. Natural diamonds also resell well below retail price. Neither is an investment.
- Diamonds are graded by IGI or GIA on the standard 4Cs scale regardless of origin.
- Every Ring Mint ring is delivered with an independent appraisal and the stone's grading report.
- There is no separate concierge fee. Clients pay for the stone and the ring.

## Payment and returns

- Payment is split in two: a 50% deposit on the center stone, and a 50% deposit on production of the final ring. The remaining balance is due after the finished ring is reviewed, before it ships.
- Diamonds and deposits are refundable for up to 25 days, or until production begins on the final ring, whichever comes first.
- Custom rings are not returnable once production has started, because they are made to the client's specification. Ring Mint will re-work or refine a piece, or liquidate it and apply credit as close to cost as possible.
- Ring Mint guarantees its work against defects and manufacturing problems.
- All shipping is fully insured.
